import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.JacobianDataCharts

/-!
# A NON-ATLAS INHABITANT OF THE `pic0TypeFunctor` REPRESENTABILITY SLOT

**HEADLINE CORRECTED after a fresh-context audit (`I-1573`), and the correction is the more
useful statement.**  This file first claimed to be "a second route to `JacobianData` with none
of the three atlas antecedents", on the strength of an enumeration of seven producers said to
consume the same chart family.  **That enumeration was wrong three ways**, and a lane pricing
work off it would be misled:

* it *omitted* producers — `JacobianData.ofRepresentableBy`, `ofAbelLifts`,
  `ofChartsOfAbelLifts`, `ofPic0ClassSurjective`, `PicRepDatum.toJacobianData`,
  `toJacobianDataOfAbelLifts`, `JacobianData.baseChange`;
* two of the seven it *did* name take an arbitrary representation and no chart at all
  (`ofAbelImage`, and `toJacobianData` in the `PicRepDatum` file), so "the antecedents belong
  to one route" was already legible in two pre-existing signatures.  This file is **not** what
  blocks that inference;
* and `jacobianData_of_subsingleton` below **is** `JacobianData.ofRepresentableBy` applied to a
  new `rep`.  So it is not a second route to the goal at all.

What it actually is, and this is defensible: **the first inhabitant of
`(pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy` that is not built from a chart atlas.**  Before it, the
only producers of that slot were `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` (`Pic0SigmaSheaf.lean:161`) and
its chart-family derivatives — every one of them carrying `IsChartUniv` and the coverage
instance.  The slot now has an inhabitant that carries neither, and the general constructor
`ofRepresentableBy` turns it into the goal object for free.

Read that as a statement about the **slot**, not about the goal.  Census the slot you fill.

## The mechanism

`JacobianData` has four fields: a representing object `J`, the universal property `rep`,
`LocallyOfFiniteType J.hom`, and `QuasiCompact J.hom`.  Take
`J := Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec k))`.  Then `J.hom` is the identity, so the two certificate fields
are `inferInstance` — *both* of the finiteness obligations the atlas route spends whole
rows on (`dat-j`, `dat-glue.atlas-hcpt`, the `hD`/`hcpt` pair) are free here, for the
reason that the object is the base.

That leaves `rep`, and at the terminal object it is cheap in the other direction:
`Hom(T, Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec k)))` is a *singleton* for every `T`, so a natural bijection with
`pic⁰(T)` exists exactly when `pic⁰(T)` is a singleton too.  Hence:

**`Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T)` at every test `T` ⟹ `JacobianData C`.**

No atlas, no divisor representability, no chart certificate, no coverage, no Abel map, no
index finiteness.

## What this is honestly worth

The hypothesis is **strong** — it says the Jacobian is a point — and it is *false* for
every curve of positive genus.  That is not a defect of the route; it is the route's
content.  Three things follow that are not available without it:

1. **The `rep` slot has a non-atlas inhabitant.**  `pic0RepresentableBy_terminal_of_subsingleton`
   fills `(pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy` with no `IsChartUniv` and no coverage instance in
   scope, which no prior producer of that slot does.  *(This bullet used to say the file made
   the three antecedents "route-specific, provably"; that was the overclaim corrected at the top
   — two pre-existing signatures already showed it.)*
2. **`Genus0Terminal` gains its missing direction.**  `Albanese/Genus0Terminal.lean` proves
   a datum *plus* vanishing gives a terminal `d.J`, and its header records the vanishing
   implication as "the single mathematical debt of S11".  Nobody wrote the direction that
   *produces* the datum from the vanishing, which is the direction with no antecedents.  It
   is landed downstream, in `Albanese/Genus0VanishingDatum.lean` — not here, because
   `Genus0Terminal` imports the Abel material and this file sits below it.  Its consequence,
   stated at the size that is actually proved (`I-1575`): the S11 chain runs from the vanishing
   alone **at that carrier**, needing no datum from elsewhere.  It is *not* the claim that the
   leaf was gated behind `divRep` — the row already says it was not.
3. **A `picEt`-level sufficient condition, statable over RINGS.**  `picEt C T` is by
   construction a subgroup of a *product* over `T.left.affineOpens` valued in
   `PicEtAff C Γ(T.left, U)`, so a subsingleton at every test *algebra* gives one at every test
   *object* componentwise — no cover, no gluing, no naturality
   (`subsingleton_picEt_of_affine`), and the converse holds by the affine comparison
   (`subsingleton_picEtAff_of_forall`).  So the two *`picEt`* quantifiers are one hypothesis.

   **CORRECTED (`I-1574`): this is NOT "the debt becomes a statement about rings".**  The bridge
   from there to the hypothesis this file actually consumes is `subsingleton_pic0_of_affine`,
   which runs **one way only** — as its own docstring says.  Vanishing `picEt` is strictly
   stronger than vanishing `pic⁰`, and the genus-0 curve is exactly a case where `pic⁰` vanishes
   and `picEt` need not: a degree-one class is a `picEt` class and is not degree zero.  So the
   ring form is a *sufficient condition*, and an attack on the real debt should target
   `pic0Subgroup` directly.

## What this does NOT do

It does not represent `pic0Functor` for a curve of positive genus, and it does not weaken
the genus-0 debt: deriving the vanishing hypothesis from `genus C = 0` is the curve theory
`Genus0Terminal`'s header isolates, and nothing here supplies it.  In particular
`jacobianData_of_subsingleton` is **not** a witness that `JacobianData C` is inhabited for
the challenge curve.

**And the hypothesis is still UNMEASURED in this tree**, though one clause of the original note
has since become false and the correction narrows what remains.  Nothing here proves the
vanishing or its negation for any curve.  What the note *also* said — "no object in the tree
carries all three of `SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1`, `IsProper`, `GeometricallyIrreducible`" —
**was true when written and is now false**: `Curve/P1Curve.lean` supplies all three at
`P1.asOver k` for an arbitrary field, and `jacobianData_of_subsingleton (P1.asOver k) h`
elaborates.  So the producer below is applicable at a concrete curve; what it still lacks there
is the hypothesis `h`, since `genus (P1.asOver k) = 0` is a cohomological computation nothing in
the tree performs.  The sentence above about positive genus still rests on mathematics outside
the formalization — `ℙ¹` is the genus-`0` object and gives no positive-genus witness — so
"false at positive genus" still reads as a measurement and still is not one.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0RepresentableBy_terminal_of_subsingleton` — **the non-atlas inhabitant
  of the `rep` slot**, at the terminal object, from vanishing `pic⁰`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.jacobianData_of_subsingleton` — `ofRepresentableBy` applied to it.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.subsingleton_picEt_of_affine` / `subsingleton_pic0_of_affine` — the
  `picEt`-level reduction to test rings, componentwise, and its one-way descent to `pic⁰`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.subsingleton_picEtAff_of_forall` — the converse of the *first* of those.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.jacobianData_of_affine_subsingleton` — the producer with the
  ring-level hypothesis.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0Subgroup_eq_bot_of_subsingleton` /
  `subsingleton_of_pic0Subgroup_eq_bot` — the two spellings of the hypothesis are
  interderivable, so `Genus0Terminal`'s `= ⊥` form and this file's `Subsingleton` form are
  not a fork.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra

noncomputable section

/-! ## The two certificate fields at the terminal object

Both are `inferInstance`, and they are recorded as named lemmas because the atlas route
spends two board rows on exactly these obligations (`dat-j` for `quasiCompact`,
`dat-glue.atlas-hcpt` for its `CompactSpace` spelling).  At this carrier they cost
nothing, and the reason is structural rather than lucky: the structure morphism *is* an
identity, so any morphism property containing identities holds. -/

/-- `LocallyOfFiniteType` at the terminal object: the structure morphism is `𝟙`. -/
theorem locallyOfFiniteType_terminal :
    LocallyOfFiniteType (Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))).hom := by
  change LocallyOfFiniteType (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
  infer_instance

/-- `QuasiCompact` at the terminal object: the structure morphism is `𝟙`. -/
theorem quasiCompact_terminal :
    QuasiCompact (Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))).hom := by
  change QuasiCompact (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
  infer_instance

/-! ## The `rep` field at the terminal object -/

variable (C) in
/-- **The degree-zero Picard functor is represented by the terminal object as soon as it
vanishes.**

The `Hom`-set `T ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec k))` is a singleton (`Over.mkIdTerminal`), so the
bijection with `pic⁰(T)` is the unique map in each direction, and both round trips are
`Subsingleton.elim`.  Naturality is likewise a `Subsingleton.elim`, at the *source* test:
this is the one place the hypothesis is needed at `T` rather than at `T'`.

Note what is NOT assumed: no atlas, no chart, no divisor functor, no representation of
anything else.  The only input is that the functor's values are singletons. -/
def pic0RepresentableBy_terminal_of_subsingleton
    (h : ∀ T : Over (Spec (.of k)), Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T)) :
    (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy (Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))) where
  homEquiv {T} :=
    { toFun := fun _ => 1
      invFun := fun _ => Over.mkIdTerminal.from T
      left_inv := fun _ => Over.mkIdTerminal.hom_ext _ _
      right_inv := fun x => @Subsingleton.elim (pic0Subgroup C T) (h T) 1 x }
  homEquiv_comp {T _T'} _g _x := by
    haveI : Subsingleton ((pic0TypeFunctor C).obj (op T)) := h T
    apply Subsingleton.elim

variable (C) in
/-- **The datum from vanishing `pic⁰` alone**, via the general constructor.

This is `JacobianData.ofRepresentableBy` fed the non-atlas `rep` above and the two identity
certificates.  So it carries none of the five inputs `jacobianDataOfMixedParamCharts`'
docstring enumerates (`rep`, `hf`, the `IsLocallySurjective` instance, `hD`, `hcpt`).

**What that is and is not evidence of** — corrected after audit (`I-1573`).  It is *not* a
"second route" establishing that the chart antecedents belong to one route: `ofAbelImage`
(`JacobianDataAbelImage.lean`) and `PicRepDatum.toJacobianData`
(`JacobianDataFromPicRepDatum.lean`) already take an arbitrary representation and no chart, so
two pre-existing signatures showed that.  This declaration is the *composition* of the general
constructor with a new inhabitant of the `rep` slot, and the new part is the inhabitant.

**The hypothesis is strong, and its truth value is unmeasured here.**  `Subsingleton
(pic0Subgroup C T)` at every `T` says the Jacobian is a point.  Nothing in this tree proves it
or refutes it for any curve; that it fails at positive genus is mathematics from outside. -/
def jacobianData_of_subsingleton
    (h : ∀ T : Over (Spec (.of k)), Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T)) :
    JacobianData C :=
  JacobianData.ofRepresentableBy C _
    (pic0RepresentableBy_terminal_of_subsingleton C h)
    locallyOfFiniteType_terminal quasiCompact_terminal

@[simp]
lemma jacobianData_of_subsingleton_J
    (h : ∀ T : Over (Spec (.of k)), Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T)) :
    (jacobianData_of_subsingleton C h).J = Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :=
  rfl

/-! ## The hypothesis, reduced to test RINGS

The producer above needs a statement at every test *object* of `Over (Spec k)` — a
scheme-level quantifier.  This section removes it: the same hypothesis at every test
scheme-level quantifier.  This section removes it: the same hypothesis at every test
*algebra* suffices, and the reduction is componentwise rather than by descent.

The reason is the vehicle chosen for `picEt` (inbox `I-0140`): `picEt C T` is *defined*
as a subgroup of `Π U : T.left.affineOpens, PicEtAff C Γ(T.left, U)`.  A product of
subsingletons is a subsingleton, and a subgroup of one is one.  So there is no cover to
choose, no compatibility to check, and no naturality to transport — `picEt.ext` is the
whole proof.

This is worth isolating because it is the step a lane would expect to be expensive.  The
Zariski-sheaf machinery for `pic⁰` exists (`Pic0ZariskiSheaf.lean`,
`PicEtCoverBridge.lean`) and a reduction to affines through *it* would need a cover, the
S-lemma and the gluing seam.  None of that is needed for a *subsingleton* hypothesis,
because subsingleton-ness is inherited by subobjects rather than glued.

The two `picEt`-level statements carry an `omit`, and it is a measurement rather than
tidying: they use **none** of the curve's geometry — not smoothness, not properness, not
geometric irreducibility.  A reduction that needed the curve would be a statement about
this particular Picard functor; these are statements about the vehicle. -/

omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
variable (C) in
/-- **The scheme-level quantifier reduces to test algebras, componentwise.**

If `PicEtAff C A` is a subsingleton for every test algebra `A`, then `picEt C T` is a
subsingleton for every test object `T`.

One line, because `picEt C T` is a subgroup of the product of the `PicEtAff C Γ(T.left, U)`
and `picEt.ext` says two sections agree as soon as they agree at each affine open. -/
theorem subsingleton_picEt_of_affine
    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A], Subsingleton (PicEtAff C A))
    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Subsingleton (picEt C T) :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => picEt.ext fun U => @Subsingleton.elim _ (h Γ(T.left, U.1)) _ _⟩

omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
variable (C) in
/-- **THE CONVERSE**, so the previous lemma is an equivalence and not a weakening.

If `picEt C T` is a subsingleton at every test object then in particular at the affine test
`overSpec k A`, and the affine comparison `picEtAffineEquiv` is a bijection onto
`PicEtAff C A`.

Recorded because a reduction whose hypothesis is strictly stronger than its conclusion
hides the gap instead of naming it.  Here the two are interderivable, so "vanishing at
every test ring" and "vanishing at every test object" are the *same* hypothesis, and a lane
may attack whichever is convenient. -/
theorem subsingleton_picEtAff_of_forall
    (h : ∀ T : Over (Spec (.of k)), Subsingleton (picEt C T))
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] : Subsingleton (PicEtAff C A) :=
  haveI := h (overSpec k A)
  (picEtAffineEquiv C A).toEquiv.symm.subsingleton

variable (C) in
/-- **The degree-zero form**: `pic0Subgroup C T` is a subgroup of `picEt C T`, so it
inherits the subsingleton.

Note the direction of the inheritance, since it is what makes the ring-level hypothesis
*sufficient but not necessary*: vanishing of the whole `picEt` gives vanishing of `pic⁰`,
never the reverse.  `picEt` does not vanish for a curve with a degree-one class even when
`pic⁰` does, so a lane attacking the genus-0 debt should attack `pic0Subgroup` directly and
use this lemma only as the cheap sufficient condition it is. -/
theorem subsingleton_pic0_of_affine
    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A], Subsingleton (PicEtAff C A))
    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T) :=
  haveI := subsingleton_picEt_of_affine C h T
  ⟨fun _ _ => Subtype.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩

variable (C) in
/-- **The producer with the ring-level hypothesis**: `JacobianData C` from vanishing at
every test *algebra*.

Composite of `subsingleton_pic0_of_affine` with `jacobianData_of_subsingleton`.  This is
the form to quote when pricing the route, because its hypothesis mentions no scheme, no
open, and no test object — only the plus construction at a commutative `k`-algebra. -/
def jacobianData_of_affine_subsingleton
    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A], Subsingleton (PicEtAff C A)) :
    JacobianData C :=
  jacobianData_of_subsingleton C (subsingleton_pic0_of_affine C h)

/-! ## `Subsingleton` and `= ⊥` are the same hypothesis

`Genus0Terminal.lean` states its input as `pic0Subgroup C T = ⊥`; this file states it as
`Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T)`.  Both directions are two lines, and having them means
neither spelling is a fork. -/

/-- A subsingleton subgroup is trivial. -/
theorem pic0Subgroup_eq_bot_of_subsingleton {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    (h : Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T)) : pic0Subgroup C T = ⊥ :=
  haveI := h
  (Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall _).mpr fun x hx =>
    congrArg Subtype.val (Subsingleton.elim (⟨x, hx⟩ : pic0Subgroup C T) 1)

/-- A trivial subgroup is a subsingleton. -/
theorem subsingleton_of_pic0Subgroup_eq_bot {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    (h : pic0Subgroup C T = ⊥) : Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T) := by
  rw [h]; infer_instance

end

end AlgebraicGeometry

/-- **THE PRODUCER FIRES.**  Under the vanishing, `pic0TypeFunctor C` is representable.

Stated as an `∃`/`Nonempty` because the representing object `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts`
returns is spelled through mathlib's glue data of the very `hf` being supplied, so naming it
in the conclusion would force the reader to reconstruct the term.  What matters is that the
seam machine *runs* on this input: an earlier version of this file claimed
`seamPair_abelSigmaChartZero_of_subsingleton` gave "both antecedents of
`pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` at once", which was **false as an applicability claim** — the
producer's antecedent 2 is an instance on `Sigma.desc f`, not on `f`, and `inferInstance` does
not cross that gap.  The `Sigma.ι_desc` factorisation below is the missing line, and this
theorem exists so that the gap cannot silently reopen. -/
theorem exists_representableBy_pic0TypeFunctor_of_subsingleton
    (pi' : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsAffineHom pi']
    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ))
    (hvan : ∀ S : Over (Spec (.of k)), Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C S)) :
    ∃ J : Over (Spec (.of k)), Nonempty ((pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J) := by
  set f := fun _ : PUnit.{u+1} => abelSigmaChartZero (C := C) (pi := pi') m Z hdeg with hfdef
  have hpair := seamPair_abelSigmaChartZero_of_subsingleton C pi' m Z hdeg hvan
  haveI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f) := by
    haveI := hpair.2
    exact Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_of_isLocallySurjective_fac
      (J := Scheme.zariskiTopology)
      (f₁ := Sigma.ι (fun _ : PUnit.{u+1} =>
        yoneda.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))).left) PUnit.unit)
      (f₂ := Sigma.desc f) (Sigma.ι_desc f PUnit.unit)
  exact ⟨_, ⟨pic0RepresentableByOfCharts C f (fun _ => hpair.1)⟩⟩

# THE SEAM PAIR IS INHABITED, AND ITS INHABITANT IS EXACTLY VANISHING `pic⁰`

**Three** roadmap rows defer to one sentence — *"inhabitation of the pair `(huniv V, hcov V)`
is UNMEASURED at every `V` and may be empty everywhere"* — namely `AJCR.w4-rep`,
`…datum.atlas-coupling` and `…datum.chart-restrict`; in Lean the sentence appears verbatim in
exactly one other file, `Pic0ChartSeamCollapse.lean:13`, from which the paragraph you are
reading inherited it.  (**An earlier version of this paragraph said "four rows and three file
headers" and named `Pic0ChartRestrictedFibreSat`, `Pic0ChartVMonotone` and
`Pic0ChartBotRefute` as carrying it.  A normalized-whitespace search finds it in none of the
three** — `Pic0ChartBotRefute.lean:107` says the materially weaker "no measured inhabitant at
any `V`".  Corrected because inflating the count inflates what this file unblocks.)

Every predecessor result is an *endpoint* result — the pair's coverage clause is refuted at
`V = ⊥`, antecedent 1 is free there, and antecedent 1 is maximal at `V = ⊤` — and
`Pic0ChartSeamCollapse` identifies the pair with `IsIso` of the chart map without exhibiting
or refuting one.

**This file decides it.**  At the chart whose `rep` slot is filled by the landed degree-zero
producer, the pair is *equivalent* to a hypothesis that already has a name elsewhere in the
tree:

  `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf f ∧ IsLocallySurjective f  ↔  ∀ S, Subsingleton (pic⁰(S))`

Both directions, with no `V`-restriction, no chart index constraint beyond the free `hdeg` at
parameter `0`, and no hypothesis on the curve beyond its standing package.

## Why this parameter, and why it is not a degenerate dodge

The chart is `abelSigmaChartZero` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyDegreeZeroUseSite.lean`), the Abel
chart at parameter `0`, whose `rep` binder is discharged by `divFunctorZeroRepresentableBy`.
Its source is the representing object's underlying scheme — and at parameter `0` that object
is the *terminal* `Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec k))`, so the source is `Spec k` itself and the chart map
sends a point `v : T ⟶ Spec k` to the Σ-element `⟨v, class⟩`.

That shape is what makes both directions cheap, and in *opposite* ways:

* **Antecedent 1 is free**, because the Σ-component of the chart value **is** the point:
  reading it off recovers `v`, so the map is injective on the nose at every test
  (`injective_abelSigmaChartZero_sigmaComponent`).  This is not the `V = ⊥` degeneracy — the source is
  nonempty and the statement is at the unrestricted chart.
* **Antecedent 2 is exactly the vanishing**, because the Σ-component is *surjective* for free
  and the fibre component then has to be hit, which at a singleton `pic⁰` it is
  (`surjective_app_abelSigmaChartZero_of_subsingleton`).  Conversely a *second* degree-zero
  class at one test defeats surjectivity, so the vanishing is not merely sufficient
  (`subsingleton_pic0Subgroup_of_surjective_app`).

So the pair, at this chart, is one hypothesis wearing two hats — and it is the hypothesis
`Picard/Pic0VanishingRoute.lean` produces `JacobianData` from by a route with *none* of the
atlas's antecedents.  The two routes are not alternatives: they close together.

## What is reused rather than rebuilt

`Pic0ChartSeamCollapse.chartIso_of_seam` takes `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` and extracts
injectivity from it via `IsOpenImmersion.le_monomorphisms`.  Here injectivity is available
*directly*, which is strictly less than that antecedent, so the collapse is restated on the
weaker input (`chartIso_of_injective`).  That restatement has an independent payoff, recorded
below as `isOpenImmersion_presheaf_of_injective`: **given coverage, antecedent 1 IS plain
elementwise injectivity** — the two-clause `MorphismProperty.relative` reading that
`Pic0ChartOpenImmersionCriterion` prices as a fibre-presentation datum collapses to an
injectivity statement once antecedent 2 is in hand.  A lane holding coverage owes injectivity
and nothing more.

## What this does NOT do

* **It does not represent `pic⁰` for a curve of positive genus.**  Mathematically the
  hypothesis is false there, and `not_seamPair_abelSigmaChartZero_of_two_pic0` converts any two
  distinct degree-zero classes over one test into a refutation of the pair.  **But note what
  is and is not landed**: nothing in this tree proves `0 < genus C → ∃ S, ¬ Subsingleton
  (pic0Subgroup C S)`, so the refutation is a *conditional* one awaiting that input, not a
  theorem about positive-genus curves.  (`Picard/Pic0ChartForkNegativeBranch.lean` refutes
  chart-map injectivity at a degree with two sections; that is a statement about `divFamZar`
  sections at parameter `n`, **not** about two `pic0Subgroup` elements, so it does not supply
  this bullet's input either.)
* **It does not supply the vanishing.**  `genus C = 0 → pic0Subgroup C S = ⊥` is real curve
  theory, is the debt `Albanese/Genus0Terminal.lean` isolates, and nothing here proves it.
* **It says nothing about a `V` strictly between `⊥` and `⊤` at a positive-genus curve.**  The
  interval question those three rows ask is answered *at this parameter only*, and there the
  `Opens` lattice of the chart source has no interior to ask about: it is `{⊥, ⊤}`, inhabited
  at `⊤` under the vanishing and refuted at `⊥`.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartIso_of_injective` — the collapse from **plain injectivity** plus
  coverage, weakening `chartIso_of_seam`'s first input.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_presheaf_of_injective` — **given coverage, antecedent 1
  is elementwise injectivity.**  Chart-free, divisor-free, curve-free.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.sigmaComponent_abelSigmaChartZero` — the Σ-component of the terminal
  chart's value is the point itself.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.injective_abelSigmaChartZero_sigmaComponent` — **antecedent 1's elementwise content,
  unconditionally**, at the unrestricted chart.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.surjective_app_abelSigmaChartZero_of_subsingleton` /
  `subsingleton_pic0Subgroup_of_surjective_app` — surjectivity **is** the vanishing, both ways.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_abelSigmaChartZero_of_subsingleton` — the chart is an isomorphism
  of presheaves under the vanishing.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.seamPair_abelSigmaChartZero_of_subsingleton` — **THE INHABITANT**: both
  seam antecedents at once.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.seamPair_abelSigmaChartZero_iff` — **the decision**, as an iff.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.not_seamPair_abelSigmaChartZero_of_two_pic0` — the refutation at any
  curve with two distinct degree-zero classes at one test.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallySurjective_abelSigmaChartZero_iff` — **the sharp form**:
  antecedent 2 *alone* is the equivalence; antecedent 1 rides free on both sides.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_representableBy_pic0TypeFunctor_of_subsingleton` — **the producer
  fires**: `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` actually runs on this input, across the
  `Sigma.desc` gap that the pair statement alone does not cross.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_presheaf_abelSigmaChart_of_mono_of_cov` — **the repricing
  at arbitrary parameter**, and the most reusable statement here: with `Mono D.hom`, coverage
  implies antecedent 1 for the general Abel chart at any `n`.
-/

   391	/-- **The canonical rank-one divisor of a membership certificate**: the unique widened
   392	divisor class over the test algebra whose Abel value is the rank-one plus class, chosen
   393	from `existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_mem`.  No Noetherian hypothesis. -/

   395	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   396	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]

   399	    DivFamZarAff C A (genus C) :=
   400	  (existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_mem pi hpi hlam).choose

   402	/-- The canonical rank-one divisor satisfies the Abel equation: its widened Abel value is
   403	the input rank-one plus class. -/
   404	theorem canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem_abel
   405	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   406	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   407	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   408	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A))) :
   409	    abelDivAffPlus C A (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem pi hpi hlam)
   410	      = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 :=
   411	  (existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_mem pi hpi hlam).choose_spec.1
   412	
   413	/-- Any Abel-correct widened divisor class equals the canonical rank-one divisor. -/
   414	theorem canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem_unique
   415	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)

     9	/-!
    10	# The chart-typed divisor functor maps into the WIDENED one (R2)
    11	
    12	`divFamZarToAffVehicle` (`…AffVehicle.lean`) carries a chart-typed vehicle section to a widened
    13	one at each affine open of a test.  Now that both sides are functors —`divFunctor`
    14	(`DivisorFamilyZarFunctor.lean`) and `divFunctorAff` (`…AffMap.lean`) — the comparison can be
    15	stated where a consumer actually uses it: as a **natural transformation** of presheaves on the
    16	slice over `Spec k`.
    17	
    18	## Why this is the shape that matters
    19	
    20	A consumer holding a chart-typed section over a general test `T` does not want to know that the
    21	two carriers agree affine-open by affine-open; it wants to substitute the widened functor for the
    22	chart-typed one and keep its restriction maps.  That is exactly naturality, and it is the
    23	statement `DivRepGlobalData`-style clauses (which are equations between *restrictions*) can
    24	consume.
    25	
    26	The proof is one application of the widened uniqueness `divFamZarAff.mapVal_eq_of`: the
    27	componentwise image of the chart-typed glued value already has the widened pullback property,
    28	because `DivFamZar.toAff_mapAlgHom` turns each clause of the chart-typed `mapVal_spec` into the
    29	corresponding widened clause.  No gluing is redone.
    30	
    31	## The direction, and it is not an omission
    32	
    33	Old → new only.  A widened certificate cover is an arbitrary family of affine opens, and by
    34	`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 3 §2 / ADDENDUM 4 §4.3 there is a straddling divisor at every
    35	genus `≥ 2` that no fixed pair of `P¹` charts can confine — so no natural transformation back can
    36	exist.  That failure is the content of R2 (protection I-0492), not a gap in this file.
    37	
    38	## Main declarations
    39	
    40	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarToAffVehicle_map` — the comparison commutes with restriction along
    41	  an arbitrary morphism of test objects.
    42	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFunctorToAff` — the natural transformation `divFunctor ⟶ divFunctorAff`.
    43	-/

    68	`toAff`-image of a clause of the chart-typed `divFamZar.mapVal_spec`
    69	(`DivFamZar.toAff_mapAlgHom`). -/

    11	/-!
    12	# Descent of the canonical rank-one divisor from an étale witness
    13	
    14	Assuming the rank-one divisor **uniqueness interface** (`RankOneDivisorUniqueness`): over any
    15	affine test whose plus class lies in the rank-one locus, at most one widened divisor class has
    16	that Abel value — the missing-item interface to be discharged by a later session.
    17	
    18	Under this hypothesis, a widened divisor over the carrier of an étale cover of the test whose
    19	Abel value is the restricted input class **descends uniquely** to the test algebra
    20	(`existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness`): uniqueness at the tensor square of the
    21	carrier manufactures the two-coprojection agreement demanded by the faithfully-flat descent
    22	theorem `DivFamZarAff.exists_descent_of_tensor_eq`, and the Abel value of the descended class
    23	is pinned by étale separatedness of `PicEtAff`.
    24	
    25	The first consumer is the finite glue on a Noetherian presentation carrier
    26	(`existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation`), whose Abel conjunct is exactly the
    27	étale witness above.  The unique class is then extracted as the **canonical rank-one divisor**
    28	of a presentation (`canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation`), with its Abel equation and
    29	uniqueness accessors.
    30	
    31	This file does not construct `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`, does not prove independence of
    32	the chosen presentation beyond what uniqueness already gives, and does not discharge the
    33	uniqueness interface itself.
    34	-/
    35	
    36	set_option autoImplicit false
    37	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    38	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
    39	depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
    40	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    41	
    42	universe u
    43	
    44	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    45	open scoped TensorProduct
    46	
    47	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    48	
    49	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    50	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    51	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    52	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    53	
    54	/-- **The rank-one divisor uniqueness interface**: over every affine test whose plus class
    55	lies in the rank-one locus, at most one widened locally certified divisor class of degree
    56	`genus C` has Abel value the input class.
    57	
    58	This is the sanctioned missing-item interface of the canonical-divisor route: producers prove
    59	existence (the finite glue and its descent below), while injectivity of the widened Abel map
    60	on the rank-one locus is to be discharged by a later session.  Stated as a named `Prop` so
    61	consumers can take it as a single hypothesis. -/
    62	def RankOneDivisorUniqueness : Prop :=
    63	  ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
    64	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k S)),
    65	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k S)) →
    66	    ∀ F G : DivFamZarAff C S (genus C),
    67	      abelDivAffPlus C S F = picEtAffineEquiv C S lam.1 →
    68	      abelDivAffPlus C S G = picEtAffineEquiv C S lam.1 → F = G
    69	
    70	/-- **Descent of an Abel-correct divisor witness along an étale cover**: a widened divisor
    71	class over the carrier of an étale cover of `A` whose Abel value is the restriction of the
    72	input rank-one plus class descends to a unique Abel-correct widened divisor class over `A`.
    73	
    74	The tensor-square cocycle condition of `DivFamZarAff.exists_descent_of_tensor_eq` is not
    75	assumed: it is manufactured from the uniqueness interface, applied over the tensor square of
    76	the carrier to the two coprojection pullbacks of the witness — both have Abel value the
    77	restriction of the input class along the (single) structure map `A → E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier`,
    78	because the two coprojections agree after the structure map of the cover.  The Abel value of
    79	the descended class is recovered by étale separatedness of `PicEtAff`
    80	(`PicEtAff.map_injective_of_etaleCover`). -/
    81	theorem existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness
    82	    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
    83	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    84	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A))
    85	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
    86	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (F' : DivFamZarAff C E.Carrier (genus C))
    87	    (habel : abelDivAffPlus C E.Carrier F' =
    88	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
    89	        (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) :
    90	    ∃! F : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C),
    91	      abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 := by
    92	  classical
    93	  set φ0 : A →ₐ[k] E.Carrier := (Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k with hφ0
    94	  set φL : E.Carrier →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier :=
    95	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
    96	      E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k with hφL
    97	  set φR : E.Carrier →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier :=
    98	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
    99	      E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k with hφR
   100	  set ψ : A →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier := φL.comp φ0 with hψ
   101	  -- both coprojections restrict to the structure map of the tensor square
   102	  have hψR : φR.comp φ0 = ψ := by
   103	    rw [hψ]
   104	    exact AlgHom.ext fun a =>
   105	      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
   106	        E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).commutes a).trans
   107	        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
   108	          E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).commutes a).symm
   109	  -- the input class restricted to the tensor square stays in the rank-one locus
   110	  set lam_sq : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ)
   111	      (overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier)) :=
   112	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map (Over.overSpecMap ψ).op lam with hlam_sq_def
   113	  have hlam_sq : lam_sq ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj
   114	      (op (overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier))) :=
   115	    picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi (Over.overSpecMap ψ).op hlam
   116	  have hsq : picEtAffineEquiv C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq.1
   117	      = PicEtAff.mapAlg C ψ (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) :=
   118	    picEtAffineEquiv_naturality C ψ lam.1
   119	  -- both coprojection pullbacks of the witness have the restricted Abel value
   120	  have habelL : abelDivAffPlus C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier)
   121	        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φL F')
   122	      = picEtAffineEquiv C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq.1 := by
   123	    rw [hsq, ← abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom φL F', habel, ← PicEtAff.mapAlg_comp, ← hψ]
   124	  have habelR : abelDivAffPlus C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier)
   125	        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φR F')
   126	      = picEtAffineEquiv C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq.1 := by
   127	    rw [hsq, ← abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom φR F', habel, ← PicEtAff.mapAlg_comp, hψR]
   128	  -- uniqueness over the tensor square manufactures the descent cocycle
   129	  have htensor : DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φL F' = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φR F' :=
   130	    hu (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq hlam_sq _ _ habelL habelR
   131	  obtain ⟨F, hF, -⟩ := DivFamZarAff.exists_descent_of_tensor_eq E F' htensor
   132	  rw [← hφ0] at hF
   133	  -- the Abel value of the descended class, by étale separatedness of `PicEtAff`
   134	  have hmapF : PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ0 (abelDivAffPlus C A F)
   135	      = PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ0 (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) := by
   136	    rw [abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom φ0 F, hF, habel]
   137	  have habelF : abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 := by
   138	    apply PicEtAff.map_injective_of_etaleCover C E
   139	    rw [PicEtAff.mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap C φ0 rfl,
   140	      PicEtAff.mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap C φ0 rfl] at hmapF
   141	    exact hmapF
   142	  exact ⟨F, habelF, fun G hG => hu A lam hlam G F hG habelF⟩
   143	
   144	/-- **The unique Abel-correct divisor of a rank-one local presentation**: over a rank-one
   145	plus class with a tied local presentation on a Noetherian étale carrier, there is a unique
   146	widened divisor class over the test algebra whose Abel value is the input class.
   147	
   148	Existence: the finite glue
   149	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation.exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation`
   150	produces an Abel-correct witness over the presentation carrier, which descends by
   151	`existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness`.  Uniqueness is the interface `hu`. -/
   152	theorem existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation
   153	    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
   154	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   155	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   156	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
   157	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
   158	    ∃! F : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C),
   159	      abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 := by
   160	  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, F0, -, -, habel, -, -, -⟩ :=
   161	    P.exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation
   162	  exact existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness pi hu lam hlam P.cover F0 habel
   163	
   164	/-- **The canonical rank-one divisor of a presentation**: the unique widened divisor class
   165	over the test algebra whose Abel value is the presented rank-one plus class, chosen from
   166	`existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation`.  By uniqueness, the choice does not
   167	depend on the internal data of the glue — only on the class, the membership certificate,
   168	and the presentation carrier's Noetherianity. -/
   169	noncomputable def canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation
   170	    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
   171	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   172	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   173	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
   174	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
   175	    DivFamZarAff C A (genus C) :=
   176	  (existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation pi hu hlam P).choose
   177	
   178	/-- The canonical rank-one divisor satisfies the Abel equation: its widened Abel value is
   179	the presented rank-one plus class. -/
   180	theorem canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation_abel
   181	    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
   182	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   183	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   184	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
   185	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
   186	    abelDivAffPlus C A (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation pi hu hlam P)
   187	      = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 :=
   188	  (existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation pi hu hlam P).choose_spec.1
   189	
   190	/-- Any Abel-correct widened divisor class equals the canonical rank-one divisor. -/
   191	theorem canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation_unique
   192	    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
   193	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   194	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   195	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
   196	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   197	    (F : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C))
   198	    (hF : abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) :
   199	    F = canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation pi hu hlam P :=
   200	  (existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation pi hu hlam P).choose_spec.2 F hF
   201

    14	/-!
    15	# Discharge of the rank-one divisor uniqueness interface
    16	
    17	`rankOneDivisorUniqueness` proves `RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi` outright: over every affine
    18	test whose plus class lies in the rank-one locus, at most one widened locally certified
    19	divisor class of degree `genus C` has Abel value the input class.  No auxiliary hypotheses
    20	remain — the interface consumed by the canonical-divisor descent is closed.
    21	
    22	The proof composes the landed engines and is local-to-global twice, both times genuinely:
    23	
    24	* membership in `PicRankOneOpen` tested at the identity yields a presentation `P` of the
    25	  input class over the test algebra itself, with an étale carrier `B := P.cover.Carrier`
    26	  carrying the cocycle datum and its four rank-one certificates;
    27	* both families restrict along the faithfully flat `S → B`, where their Abel values become
    28	  the `PicEtAff.unit` of `P.representative` (`mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self`), so étale
    29	  separatedness (`PicEtAff.unit_injective`) matches both `relPic` classes with the datum's
    30	  Čech class;
    31	* near every prime of `B` the base-discrepancy localization
    32	  (`exists_notMem_cechPicMap_eq_of_relPicMk_eq`) upgrades the two `relPic` equalities to
    33	  on-the-nose `CechPic` equalities on a basic open — the two localizations are merged by
    34	  multiplying the two good elements;
    35	* on each such basic open the datum base-changes with its certificates
    36	  (`RankOneFamilyCertificates.scalarExtension`), and the datum-class uniqueness core
    37	  (`divFamZarAff_eq_of_picClass_eq_cechPicClass`) forces the two restricted families to
    38	  agree;
    39	* the good elements span the unit ideal (`exists_fin_span_eq_top_of_forall_prime`), so the
    40	  away-span separatedness (`DivFamZarAff.eq_of_awaySpan_eq`) closes equality over `B`, and
    41	  faithfully-flat injectivity (`DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_injective_of_faithfullyFlat`) closes
    42	  it over the test algebra.
    43	
    44	The rank-one hypothesis enters irreplaceably through the certificates feeding the
    45	uniqueness core's unit-extraction engine; the glue-backs cover `Spec B` and descend a
    46	faithfully flat cover of `Spec S`, so neither is the trivial converse (the two traps of the
    47	uniqueness-discharge memory).  As immediate consumers, the canonical rank-one divisor and
    48	its accessors are re-exported with the interface hypothesis discharged
    49	(`canonicalRankOneDivisor`, `existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_presentation`).
    50	-/

    92	          (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away a) (Localization.Away f))).comp

    99	/-- **Per-prime local agreement with the datum**: two widened divisor families over the
   100	presentation carrier whose `picClass`es agree with the datum's Čech class in the relative
   101	Picard group agree on the nose after restriction to a basic open around any given prime.
   102	
   103	The base-discrepancy localization produces one good element per family; their product is
   104	good for both, the datum base-changes with its four rank-one certificates, and the
   105	datum-class uniqueness core forces the two restricted families to coincide. -/
   106	theorem PicRankOneLocalPresentation.exists_notMem_mapAlgHom_eq
   107	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   108	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   109	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   110	    {F G : DivFamZarAff C P.cover.Carrier (genus C)}
   111	    (hF : relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) F.picClass
   112	        = relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) P.datum.cechPicClass)
   113	    (hG : relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) G.picClass
   114	        = relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) P.datum.cechPicClass)
   115	    (q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
   116	    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal ∧
   117	      DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   118	          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)) F
   119	        = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   120	          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)) G := by
   121	  classical
   122	  obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁, h₁⟩ := exists_notMem_cechPicMap_eq_of_relPicMk_eq hF q
   123	  obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂, h₂⟩ := exists_notMem_cechPicMap_eq_of_relPicMk_eq hG q
   124	  have hmul : f₁ * f₂ ∉ q.asIdeal := fun hmem => by
   125	    rcases q.isPrime.mem_or_mem hmem with h | h
   126	    exacts [hf₁ h, hf₂ h]
   127	  refine ⟨f₁ * f₂, hmul, ?_⟩
   128	  set B' := Localization.Away (f₁ * f₂)
   129	  -- both restricted families have `picClass` the base-changed datum class on the nose
   130	  have h₁' := cechPicMap_away_eq_of_mul (C := C) f₁ f₂ (f₁ * f₂) rfl h₁
   131	  have h₂' := cechPicMap_away_eq_of_mul (C := C) f₂ f₁ (f₁ * f₂) (mul_comm f₂ f₁) h₂
   132	  have hFpic : (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   133	      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier B') F).picClass
   134	      = (P.datum.baseChange B').cechPicClass := by
   135	    rw [DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg _ (fun _ => rfl), DivFamZarAff.picClass_mapAlg,
   136	      P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange B']
   137	    exact h₁'
   138	  have hGpic : (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   139	      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier B') G).picClass
   140	      = (P.datum.baseChange B').cechPicClass := by
   141	    rw [DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg _ (fun _ => rfl), DivFamZarAff.picClass_mapAlg,
   142	      P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange B']
   143	    exact h₂'
   144	  -- the presentation's four certificates base-change to the basic open
   145	  have cert : RankOneFamilyCertificates (P.datum.baseChange B') :=
   146	    (RankOneFamilyCertificates.mk P.h1_vanishing P.h0_finite P.h0_projective
   147	      P.h0_rank_one).scalarExtension B'
   148	  exact BasicOpenCocycleDatum.divFamZarAff_eq_of_picClass_eq_cechPicClass
   149	    (P.datum.baseChange B') cert.h1_vanishing cert.h0_finite cert.h0_projective
   150	    cert.h0_rank_one _ _ hFpic hGpic

   152	/-- **The rank-one divisor uniqueness interface holds** (the T5 discharge): over every
   153	affine test whose plus class lies in the rank-one locus, at most one widened locally
   154	certified divisor class of degree `genus C` has Abel value the input class.
   155	
   156	Injectivity is restored on the rank-one locus precisely because the presentation's `H⁰` is
   157	finite projective of stalk rank one — single-point linear systems — which feeds the
   158	unit-extraction engine of the datum-class uniqueness core; away from the locus the widened
   159	Abel map is genuinely non-injective (`Pic0ChartAbelNonInjective`). -/
   160	theorem rankOneDivisorUniqueness : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi := by
   161	  intro S _ _ lam hlam F G hF hG
   162	  classical
   163	  -- a presentation of the input class, from the identity test; its plus class is `lam.1`
   164	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mp hlam S (𝟙 (overSpec k S))
   165	  have e : ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map
   166	      (𝟙 (overSpec k S)).op lam).1 = lam.1 :=
   167	    picEtMap_id C lam.1
   168	  -- inject along the faithfully flat étale carrier
   169	  apply DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_injective_of_faithfullyFlat
   170	    (S := S) (S' := P.cover.Carrier)
   171	  set φ0 : S →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S P.cover.Carrier with hφ0
   172	  -- the restricted Abel values are the unit of the representative, so both restricted
   173	  -- `picClass`es agree with the datum's Čech class in the relative Picard group
   174	  have hofId : ((Algebra.ofId S P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k) = φ0 :=
   175	    AlgHom.ext fun _ => rfl
   176	  have hrep : PicEtAff.mk C P.cover P.representative = picEtAffineEquiv C S lam.1 := by
   177	    rw [← e]
   178	    exact P.represents
   179	  have htarget : PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ0 (picEtAffineEquiv C S lam.1)
   180	      = PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier
   181	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   182	    rw [← hrep, ← hofId, PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]
   183	  have key : ∀ H : DivFamZarAff C S (genus C),
   184	      abelDivAffPlus C S H = picEtAffineEquiv C S lam.1 →
   185	      relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   186	          (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ0 H).picClass
   187	        = relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) P.datum.cechPicClass := by
   188	    intro H hH
   189	    rw [← P.datum_class]
   190	    apply PicEtAff.unit_injective C P.cover.Carrier
   191	    calc PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier (relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   192	          (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ0 H).picClass)
   193	        = abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ0 H) := rfl
   194	      _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ0 (abelDivAffPlus C S H) :=
   195	          (abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom φ0 H).symm
   196	      _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ0 (picEtAffineEquiv C S lam.1) := by rw [hH]
   197	      _ = PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier
   198	            (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := htarget
   199	  -- per-prime agreement, upgraded to a finite spanning family, separates over the carrier
   200	  obtain ⟨m, g, hgspan, hggood⟩ := exists_fin_span_eq_top_of_forall_prime
   201	    (fun f => DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   202	        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f))
   203	        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ0 F)
   204	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   205	        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f))
   206	        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ0 G))
   207	    (fun q => P.exists_notMem_mapAlgHom_eq pi (key F hF) (key G hG) q)
   208	  exact DivFamZarAff.eq_of_awaySpan_eq g hgspan hggood
   209	
   210	/-! ## Immediate consumers: the canonical rank-one divisor, unconditionally -/
   211	
   212	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   213	  {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   214	
   215	/-- The unique Abel-correct divisor of a rank-one local presentation, with the uniqueness
   216	interface discharged. -/
   217	theorem existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_presentation
   218	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
   219	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
   220	    ∃! F : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C),
   221	      abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 :=
   222	  existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation pi
   223	    (rankOneDivisorUniqueness pi) hlam P
   224	
   225	/-- **The canonical rank-one divisor**, with the uniqueness interface discharged. -/
   226	noncomputable def canonicalRankOneDivisor
   227	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
   228	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
   229	    DivFamZarAff C A (genus C) :=
   230	  canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation pi (rankOneDivisorUniqueness pi) hlam P
   231	
   232	/-- The canonical rank-one divisor satisfies the Abel equation. -/
   233	theorem canonicalRankOneDivisor_abel
   234	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
   235	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
   236	    abelDivAffPlus C A (canonicalRankOneDivisor pi hlam P)
   237	      = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 :=
   238	  canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation_abel pi (rankOneDivisorUniqueness pi) hlam P
   239	
   240	/-- Any Abel-correct widened divisor class equals the canonical rank-one divisor. -/
   241	theorem canonicalRankOneDivisor_unique
   242	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
   243	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   244	    (F : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C))
   245	    (hF : abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) :
   246	    F = canonicalRankOneDivisor pi hlam P :=
   247	  canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation_unique pi (rankOneDivisorUniqueness pi) hlam P F hF
   248	
   249	end AlgebraicGeometry

    10	/-!
    11	# Representability of the widened divisor functor
    12	
    13	The universal widened class on every divisor chart satisfies the classifier clause, hence
    14	represents the positive-genus divisor functor by `DivScheme`.  The window bound follows from
    15	nonzero genus.  In genus zero the widened functor is terminal, so choosing finite bases internally
    16	gives an unconditional representer without adding a hypothesis to the curve data.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	set_option quotPrecheck false
    21	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

    37	section Curve

    39	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    40	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    41	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

    43	
    44	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftDivRepChartClassUnivAffRepresentable :
    45	    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    46	
    47	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
    48	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    49	  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    50	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
    51	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
    52	variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))
    53	variable (g : Nat)
    54	variable (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
    55	  (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : Int))
    56	
    57	section Based
    58	
    59	variable (r1 r2 : Nat)
    60	variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
    61	  ↥(divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
    62	variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
    63	  ↥(divisorSections k
    64	    ((windowM_choice pi hpi g + windowS_choice pi hpi g) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
    65	
    66	local notation "DivOver" =>
    67	  divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    68	    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
    69	    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm)
    70	
    71	include hO hchi in
    72	/-- For nonzero genus, the universal widened chart classes represent the divisor functor by
    73	the existing divisor scheme. -/
    74	noncomputable def divFunctorAff_representableBy_divScheme_of_ne_zero (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    75	    (divFunctorAff C g).RepresentableBy DivOver := by
    76	  let hb := windowBound_pos_of_genus_ne_zero pi hpi g hg hO hchi
    77	  exact divFunctorAff_representableBy_of_chartClause hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2
    78	    (fun i j => PointwiseAchiever.divFamZarAffUniv C hpi g r1 r2 b1
    79	      (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j hO hchi hb)
    80	    (fun i j => PointwiseAchiever.isDivRepClassifyAff_divFamZarAffUniv
    81	      C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 hO hchi i j hb)
    82	
    83	omit hchi in
    84	include hO in
    85	/-- At independent curve parameter `gamma ≤ g`, the universal widened chart classes
    86	represent the degree-`g` divisor functor by the existing divisor scheme. -/
    87	noncomputable def divFunctorAff_representableBy_divScheme_at
    88	    {gamma : Nat} (hgamma : gamma ≤ g)
    89	    (hchiGamma : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (gamma : Int)) :
    90	    (divFunctorAff C g).RepresentableBy DivOver :=
    91	  divFunctorAff_representableBy_of_chartClause_at
    92	    (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
    93	    (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (hOAt := hO) (gamma := gamma)
    94	    (hgamma := hgamma) (hchiGamma := hchiGamma)
    95	    (fun i j => PointwiseAchiever.divFamZarAffUniv_at C hpi g r1 r2 b1
    96	      (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j hgamma hchiGamma)
    97	    (fun i j => PointwiseAchiever.isDivRepClassifyAff_divFamZarAffUniv_at
    98	      C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j hgamma hchiGamma)
    99	
   100	end Based
   101	
   102	omit hchi in
   103	include hO in
   104	/-- The degree-`g` widened divisor functor has a chosen representer when the curve Euler
   105	parameter is any `gamma ≤ g`. The degree-zero branch remains the terminal object. -/
   106	noncomputable def divFunctorAffRepresenter_at
   107	    {gamma : Nat} (hgamma : gamma ≤ g)
   108	    (hchiGamma : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (gamma : Int)) :
   109	    Σ D : Over (Spec (.of k)), (divFunctorAff C g).RepresentableBy D := by
   110	  classical
   111	  clear hchi
   112	  by_cases hg : g = 0
   113	  · subst g
   114	    exact ⟨Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))),
   115	      divFunctorAffZeroRepresentableBy (C := C) (pi := pi)⟩
   116	  · let r1 := Module.finrank k
   117	      ↥(divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤)
   118	    let r2 := Module.finrank k ↥(divisorSections k
   119	      ((windowM_choice pi hpi g + windowS_choice pi hpi g) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤)
   120	    let b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
   121	        ↥(divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤) :=
   122	      Module.finBasis k _
   123	    let b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k ↥(divisorSections k
   124	        ((windowM_choice pi hpi g + windowS_choice pi hpi g) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤) :=
   125	      Module.finBasis k _
   126	    exact ⟨divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
   127	        (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
   128	        (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm),
   129	      divFunctorAff_representableBy_divScheme_at
   130	        (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO)
   131	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2)
   132	        (gamma := gamma) (hgamma := hgamma) (hchiGamma := hchiGamma)⟩
   133	
   134	include hO hchi in
   135	/-- The diagonal widened divisor representer, specialized from the arbitrary-degree producer. -/
   136	noncomputable def divFunctorAffRepresenter :
   137	    Σ D : Over (Spec (.of k)), (divFunctorAff C g).RepresentableBy D :=
   138	  divFunctorAffRepresenter_at (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   139	    (hO := hO) (gamma := g) (Nat.le_refl g) hchi
   140	
   141	/-- A chosen scheme representing the widened divisor functor. -/
   142	noncomputable def divRepAffScheme : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   143	  (divFunctorAffRepresenter C hpi g hO hchi).1
   144	
   145	omit hchi in
   146	/-- A chosen scheme representing the degree-`g` widened divisor functor at independent
   147	curve parameter `gamma ≤ g`. -/
   148	noncomputable def divRepAffScheme_at {gamma : Nat} (hgamma : gamma ≤ g)
   149	    (hchiGamma : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (gamma : Int)) :
   150	    Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   151	  (divFunctorAffRepresenter_at (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   152	    (hO := hO) (gamma := gamma) (hgamma := hgamma) (hchiGamma := hchiGamma)).1
   153	
   154	/-- The widened divisor functor is represented by its chosen scheme, with no genus or chart-basis
   155	hypothesis. -/
   156	noncomputable def divFunctorAff_representableBy :
   157	    (divFunctorAff C g).RepresentableBy (divRepAffScheme C hpi g hO hchi) :=
   158	  (divFunctorAffRepresenter C hpi g hO hchi).2
   159	
   160	omit hchi in
   161	/-- The degree-`g` widened divisor functor is represented at every independent curve
   162	parameter `gamma ≤ g`. -/
   163	noncomputable def divFunctorAff_representableBy_at
   164	    {gamma : Nat} (hgamma : gamma ≤ g)
   165	    (hchiGamma : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (gamma : Int)) :
   166	    (divFunctorAff C g).RepresentableBy
   167	      (divRepAffScheme_at (C := C) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   168	        (hO := hO) (gamma := gamma) (hgamma := hgamma) (hchiGamma := hchiGamma)) :=
   169	  (divFunctorAffRepresenter_at (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   170	    (hO := hO) (gamma := gamma) (hgamma := hgamma) (hchiGamma := hchiGamma)).2
   171	
   172	end Curve

     8	import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Subfunctor.Image
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    12	
    13	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    14	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    15	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    16	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    17	
    18	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    19	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    20	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
    21	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
    22	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    27	
    28	universe u
    29	
    30	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    35	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    36	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    37	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    38	
    39	noncomputable section
    40	
    41	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    42	
    43	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    44	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    45	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    46	def PicRankOneOpen :
    47	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    48	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    49	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    50	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    51	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    52	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    53	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    54	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    55	      apply Subtype.ext
    56	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    57	    rw [e]
    58	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
    59	
    60	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
    61	
    62	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
    63	
    64	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
    65	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
    66	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
    67	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
    68	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    69	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
    70	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    71	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    72	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    73	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))
    74	
    75	/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
    76	Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
    77	field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
    78	contract. -/
    79	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    80	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
    81	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
    82	      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    83	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    84	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    85	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
    86	  rfl
    87	
    88	/-- Constructor for the exact lambda-tied arbitrary-affine-pullback presentation contract. -/
    89	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations
    90	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    91	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    92	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    93	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    94	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    95	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
    96	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
    97	  (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mpr h
    98	
    99	/-- Constructor using the named arbitrary-affine producer predicate. -/
   100	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentationCondition
   101	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   102	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   103	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition pi lam) :
   104	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   105	  exact mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi h
   106	
   107	/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
   108	def picRankOneOpenIncl :
   109	    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
   110	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   111	
   112	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
   113	
   114	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
   115	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
   116	relative-open gate below. -/
   117	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
   118	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
   119	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
   120	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   121	
   122	/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.
   123	
   124	This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
   125	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
   126	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
   127	def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
   128	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)
   129	
   130	/-! ## The explicit fibre producer contract -/
   131	
   132	/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.
   133	
   134	The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
   135	It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
   136	supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
   137	or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
   138	structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   139	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   140	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   141	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
   142	  W : X.Opens
   143	  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   144	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
   145	  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
   146	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
   147	    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
   148	    (w : S ⟶ X),
   149	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
   150	      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
   151	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
   152	      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w
   153	
   154	namespace PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   155	
   156	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   157	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   158	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))}
   159	
   160	/-- The fibre square supplied by `FibrePresented` is a pullback of presheaves. -/
   161	theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   162	    IsPullback D.fst (yoneda.map D.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g := by
   163	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
   164	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
   165	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   166	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   167	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
   168	      φ.app S) D.sq
   169	  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
   170	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
   171	  · intro v w hvw
   172	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
   173	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩
   174	
   175	end PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   176	
   177	/-- An arbitrary-test fibre producer discharges the relative openness gate. -/
   178	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented
   179	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   180	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   181	        Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))),
   182	      PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   183	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   184	  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists ?_
   185	  intro X g
   186	  let d := D X g
   187	  exact ⟨d.W, d.fst, d.W.ι, d.isPullback, inferInstance⟩
   188	
   189	/-- Expose a supplied relative-open certificate without hiding it behind typeclass search. -/
   190	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate
   191	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi :=
   192	  h
   193	
   194	/-- Extract the open immersion supplied by the relative-openness certificate on an arbitrary
   195	pullback.  This is the exact shape consumed by an eventual chart/fibre producer. -/
   196	theorem picRankOneOpen_openPullback
   197	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
   198	    {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
   199	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   200	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))
   201	    (fst : yoneda.obj Z ⟶
   202	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor)
   203	    (snd : Z ⟶ X)
   204	    (hpb : IsPullback fst (yoneda.map snd) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g) :
   205	    IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   206	  h.property g fst snd hpb
   207	
   208	/-- Pullback stability of the public rank-one locus, exposed independently of its definition. -/
   209	theorem picRankOneOpen_map_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   210	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   211	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   212	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   213	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).map f h
   214	
   215	/-- Pullback stability of the public locus, with the base-change direction made explicit. -/
   216	theorem picRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   217	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   218	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   219	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   220	  picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi f h
   221	
   222	/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.
   223	
   224	This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
   225	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
   226	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
   227	    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
   228	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
   229	
   230	/-- The same presentation preimage on the Yoneda functor of the canonical genus divisor
   231	representer. -/
   232	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
   233	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
   234	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
   235	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
   236	
   237	/-- The affine Abel transformation restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   238	def rankOneAbelAff :
   239	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶
   240	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
   241	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).fromPreimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
   242	
   243	/-- Restrict the canonical representation isomorphism to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   244	def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :
   245	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   246	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
   247	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
   248	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
   249	
   250	/-- The represented genus Abel map restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   251	def rankOneAbelRepresented :
   252	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   253	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
   254	  rankOneRepresenterRestriction pi ≫ rankOneAbelAff pi
   255	
   256	/-- Immediate consumer theorem: the restricted represented Abel map lands in the public locus.
   257	The stronger canonical inverse still needs the family-level divisor/evaluation producer; this
   258	theorem records the exact target API that consumer lanes can use today. -/
   259	theorem rankOneAbelRepresented_mem {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   260	    (x : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).obj T) :
   261	    ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x :
   262	      (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
   263	  ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x).property
   264
